statement: Every text and UI color pair the system declares meets WCAG 2.2 AA in every brand and mode.

check.test: contrast: a text role set too close to its surface fails, naming brand, mode, both roles and both ratios, and writes nothing

statement: Text on an Artifact page meets 4.5:1, or 3:1 when large, with see-through layers composited.
The hit target token is at least 44px in every brand and mode.

check.test: hit target: a value under 44 fails the build, naming the token, and writes nothing

statement: A control that sets a pixel width or height in CSS sets at least 44px.

check.test: source rules: control-min-size fails a marked control under 44px, naming the property and selector, and passes an unmarked rule and a 44px control

statement: Every rendered interactive element has a hit area of at least 44px on each axis.
reason: A hit area is the painted box plus any pseudo-element or padding that extends it, which only a rendered component shows; the Phase 2 component tests measure it per kit component.

statement: The focus ring color meets 3:1 against every surface it can sit on, in every brand and mode.

check.test: focus ring: an accent too close to the page fails, naming the ring role, the surface and both ratios, and writes nothing

statement: Each focus ring on an Artifact page meets 3:1 against the surface around it.
Every focusable element shows a visible focus ring.
reason: The artifact checker only warns when a tabbed element has no outline (artifact/check/check.mjs, 'no visible focus outline'), and a source scan cannot know which elements are focusable or what a :focus-visible rule resolves to; it needs a rendered kit component or a stricter page checker.

statement: Every motion role declares how it behaves under reduced motion: opacity, none or instant.

check.test: reduced motion: a spring with no $reduced fails the build, naming the spring, and writes nothing

statement: A component honors the reduced-motion form its motion role declares.
reason: Whether a component swaps its spring for the declared form is behavior, not text; it needs a rendered component under prefers-reduced-motion, which the Phase 2 component tests can assert.

statement: A scrolling region does not sit inside another scrolling region.
reason: Needs the computed overflow of every ancestor in a rendered page; artifact/check has no such rule and a page checker is not being built here.

statement: Nothing sits above a title or heading only to categorize, date or restate it.
reason: Whether a line is a kicker is a judgement about its role beside a heading, in a rendered page; artifact/SKILL.md states the rule but artifact/check has no rule for it.

statement: User-facing text and markup contain no em dash.

check.test: source rules: em-dash fails an em dash, its entity and its escapes, naming file, line and rule, and passes a comment and clean text

statement: Status is written as a word, never carried by color or an icon alone.
reason: Detecting a status carried by color or an icon needs the rendered meaning of an element; artifact/check bans status hue through token-colors and icons through no-emoji-icons but cannot see a status that has no word.

statement: The accent color appears only on the primary button fill and the focus ring.
A color in CSS source is a var(); a hex or color function appears only as a var() fallback, so styles.module.css never gains a bare hex.

check.test: source rules: literal-color fails a bare hex, color function and named color, naming file, line and property, and passes a var() fallback

statement: Kit CSS takes spacing and radius from the scale tokens, not a pixel literal that a token already holds.

check.test: source rules: literal-spacing fails a pixel value a space or radius token holds, naming the token to use, and passes a var() and an off-scale value

statement: No gradients or decorative color inside the package.
reason: conflicts with the trigger highlight; wording needs Sean's call

statement: Every brand and mode sets every role base/roles.tokens.json requires, or opts out of it with a reason.

check.test: required roles: a role missing from one mode fails, naming brand, mode and role

statement: A brand sets only the token paths its lock list unlocks.

check.test: lock list: a brand that inherits the default list and sets a locked path fails, naming brand and path

statement: An opt-out names a known check, pair or role and gives a reason.

check.test: opt-out: one with no reason fails, naming the brand and the opt-out

statement: tokens/generated/ equals a fresh build of the token source.

check.test: drift: a generated file that differs, is missing or is stale fails, naming the file

statement: A color's hex equals its components.

check.test: color gate: hex and components that disagree fail, naming the token

statement: The generated Artifact contract equals artifact/snapshot/tokens.json.

check.test: snapshot gate: a changed snapshot value fails, naming the key

statement: The generated CSS declares the same tokens as artifact/head.py, for no brand and for each client brand.

check.test: head.py gate alone: generated CSS that drifts from head.py fails while the snapshot gate passes

statement: Each promoted spring equals its constant in src/motion.ts.
Every --orrery-iris-* variable the package CSS reads is written by the package or documented, and every documented variable is read.
